foods.Preparation: 1. Place an entire [{07296ec9-de5d-4259-b8da-ed946760a9b6}] into boiling water and steep for exactly 10 minutes. 2. Transfer to an ice bath immediately. 3. Peel gently, halve, and adorn strictly with [{SALT}] and [{CUP}].

foods.Description: Dry roasted salted moong lentils.
